headline: RBI to conduct second 3-day VRR auction of ₹25,000 crore on November 20, 2026
summary_points: RBI will hold a second 3-day Variable Rate Repo (VRR) auction under LAF on Friday, November 20, 2026.
The decision follows a review of current and evolving near-term liquidity conditions.
Operational guidelines remain the same as in Press Release 2021-2022/1572 dated January 20, 2022.
who_is_affected: Banks and other LAF-eligible participants, and treasury teams tracking short-term liquidity and money market rates.
action_required: Eligible participants wanting liquidity should bid within the 12:45 PM to 1:15 PM window; others may track money market impact.

social.linkedin:
RBI has announced a second 3-day Variable Rate Repo (VRR) auction under the Liquidity Adjustment Facility (LAF) on Friday, November 20, 2026.

The decision follows a review of current and evolving near-term liquidity conditions.

Key details:
- Notified amount: ₹25,000 crore
- Tenor: 3 days
- Window: 12:45 PM to 1:15 PM
- Reversal date: Monday, November 23, 2026

Operational guidelines remain the same as in Press Release 2021-2022/1572 dated January 20, 2022.

For banks, treasuries and finance teams, this is a signal worth watching for short-term liquidity and money market conditions.

Please verify the details with the official RBI press release (2026-2027/1530) before acting.
